name: When is it necessary to repair an existing foundation versus constructing a new one?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to repair an existing foundation versus constructing a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair an existing foundation versus constructing a new one depends on the extent of the damage, its underlying cause, and the overall goals of your renovation. Minor cracks or settling may be addressable with targeted repairs, while severe structural issues, extensive damage from water, or the need for a completely different footprint for a large addition often necessitate new construction. AKN Design Group conducts thorough assessments to determine the most cost-effective and structurally sound solution for your specific project. We prioritize enhancing functionality, beauty, and long-term value, guiding you toward the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a foundation is suitable for minor damage, while new construction is typically needed for severe issues or significant structural changes for an addition.
